Start date: 1184-06-30  
Add 48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Add 4 more days → total 340 days.  

1184 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100).  
From 1184-06-30:  
June has 30 days → 0 days left in June.  
July (31) + Aug (31) + Sep (30) + Oct (31) + Nov (30) + Dec (31) = 184 days in 1184.  
340 − 184 = 156 days remain into 1185.  

1185 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Jan (31) + Feb (28) + Mar (31) + Apr (30) = 120 days.  
156 − 120 = 36 days into May.  
So 1185-05-36 → 1185-06-05.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1185-06-05
